title: Logos: An Agent Harness on a Cross-Process Bus
abstract: arXiv:2608.28553v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern agent systems assemble capabilities at runtime, and this dynamic composition has recently received a complete formal treat ment in the spatiotemporal-composability calculus, in which a capability is a component carrying a tracked inverse, and agents are assembled as plugins. This plugin form is carried by a single process sharing one context, a carrier that places all components in one physical failure domain, a fault suspends every component at once, and process death interrupts every session the process hosts. This paper shows that neither the modeling nor the calculus binds an agent to one process, the statelessness of the language model keeps all cross-step state outside the model, and the soundness invariant is defined on the state space alone. translated_title: Logos：一种构建在跨进程总线之上的智能体运行框架
translated_abstract: 现代智能体系统在运行时组装能力，这种动态组合最近在时空可组合性演算中得到了完整的形式化处理，其中能力是一个携带被追踪逆元的组件，而智能体则以插件的形式组装而成。这种插件形式由共享单一上下文的单个进程承载，这种载体将所有组件置于同一个物理故障域中——一个故障会同时暂停所有组件，进程死亡会中断该进程所承载的所有会话。本文表明，无论是建模还是演算都没有将智能体绑定到单个进程上：语言模型的无状态性使所有跨步骤的状态都保持在模型之外，而可靠性不变式仅在状态空间上定义。这些观察凝结为四个引理，其前提是演算的假设以及语言模型推理的无状态性。在这些引理之上，本文构建了……
tldr: 本文证明了时空可组合性演算中的智能体插件形式并不被绑定于单进程，并基于四个引理将智能体运行框架扩展到跨进程总线上，从而突破了单一物理故障域的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the plugin form of agents in the spatiotemporal-composability calculus is not bound to a single process, and constructs an agent harness on a cross-process bus based on four lemmas, thereby escaping the single physical failure domain.
